name: sdlc
description: Work item in the SDLC pipeline. Intake trigger for CoS.

name: sdlc:stage/0
description: Stage 0 Intake. CoS owns the brief and the tier.

name: sdlc:stage/1
description: Stage 1 Requirements. Product owns requirements.md.

name: sdlc:stage/2
description: Stage 2 Architecture. Architect owns design, ADR, and the plan.

name: sdlc:stage/3
description: Stage 3 Implementation. Developer drives a Cursor cloud agent.

name: sdlc:stage/4
description: Stage 4 Review and QA. Reviewer owns the verdict.

name: sdlc:stage/5
description: Stage 5 Release. Ops owns the deploy record and the watch.

name: sdlc:stage/6
description: Stage 6 Docs. Scribe owns the docs PR. The owner merges it.

name: sdlc:stage/7
description: Stage 7 Feedback. CoS owns the retro and follow-ups.

name: sdlc:tier/T0
description: T0 fast lane. Skips requirements and architecture. The owner still merges.

name: sdlc:tier/T1
description: T1 standard. All stages. Human gates H1, H3, and H4.

name: sdlc:tier/T2
description: T2 high-risk. All stages plus H0, H2, and H5.

name: sdlc:blocked
description: Blocked. A specialist sent BLOCKED and CoS has not cleared it.

name: sdlc:awaiting-owner
description: Waiting on the owner for H0, H1, H2, H3, H4, or H5.

name: sdlc:owner/chief-of-staff
description: Current specialist is Chief of Staff.

name: sdlc:owner/product
description: Current specialist is Product.

name: sdlc:owner/architect
description: Current specialist is Architect.

name: sdlc:owner/developer
description: Current specialist is Developer.

name: sdlc:owner/reviewer
description: Current specialist is Reviewer.

name: sdlc:owner/ops
description: Current specialist is Ops.

name: sdlc:owner/scribe
description: Current specialist is Scribe.
